model: PWREP RM P8 XLR5F REAR RDMHUB
notes: Sourced from Pathway Connectivity's (an Acuity Brands company) official "REPEATER RACK-MOUNT DMX/RDM OPTO-SPLITTER" spec sheet (doc PWREP_RM, Rev. 07/27/21), obtained via a retailer's product-specs download link since pathwayconnect.com and acuitybrands.com return HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot protection) to automated fetches. This is a DMX512/RDM signal repeater/opto-splitter/hub, not a video/audio device — "control" category and "Control processor" type are the closest fits among the allowed enums (it does act as a front-panel RDM controller). Physical ports per the manufacturer's rear-panel diagram for the "XLR5F REAR RDMHUB" variant: one MASTER INPUT plus 8 bi-directional DMX512 ports (PORT A–H), all 5-pin female XLR (connector id "xlr5", carrying DMX512/RDM data — not audio, so not xlr4/xlr5 audio use). No bandwidth grade applies to DMX512/RDM so none was set. Power input is a rear IEC inlet rated 100–240VAC 50/60Hz, 0.08A max, shown in the manufacturer's rear-panel drawing as a standard IEC C13/C14-style receptacle (exact IEC sub-type not printed on the panel legend, so mapped to the general "iec" id); no explicit on-panel text label for this connector was visible in the source diagram, so it was named descriptively as "AC Power Input." Unit is 17"W x 1.7"H x 7"D (1U rack-mount, ears included), 5.2 lbs. Master Input is physically fixed as an input in the silkscreen, though in Hub/Merge mode the unit can dynamically treat any of Ports A–H as the active input (they are wired bi-directionally per the datasheet's explicit "8 bi-directional DMX512 Ports" spec).
